abort.already_configured: This CatLink Account is already configured.
abort.identifier_switched: The existing entry now signs in with the new Account Identifier.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Aliyun credentials are saved and the entry has been reloaded.
abort.wrong_account: That signed in to a different CatLink Account than this entry. Re-authenticate with the Account Identifier this entry already uses.

error.aliyun_invalid: Aliyun rejected this app key and secret. Check both and try again.
error.aliyun_required: This Account owns a Scooper Pro Ultra, which is reachable only over the Aliyun Channel. Enter the Aliyun app key and secret.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the CatLink Cloud or Aliyun. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials and try again.

user.description: The CatLink Cloud allows one Session per Account, so signing in here ends the Session on your phone. Use the share feature in the app to give Home Assistant its own Account, and share your Devices with it.
user.title: How do you sign in to the CatLink app?

email.description: Enter the Email and password you sign in to the CatLink app with. If the Account owns a Scooper Pro Ultra, also enter the Aliyun app key and secret; otherwise leave them blank. When re-authenticating, a blank secret keeps the stored one.
email.title: Sign in with Email

phone.description: Enter your full phone number with country code (e.g. +447911123456) and the password you sign in to the CatLink app with. If the Account owns a Scooper Pro Ultra, also enter the Aliyun app key and secret; otherwise leave them blank. When re-authenticating, a blank secret keeps the stored one.
phone.title: Sign in with a phone number

switch_identifier.description: This CatLink Account is already configured as {current_identifier}. Switch that entry to {new_identifier} instead of adding a second one? A second entry on the same Account would evict the first on every refresh. Your Devices, entities and automations are kept either way.
switch_identifier.title: Account already configured

reconfigure.description: Add or change the Aliyun app key and secret this entry uses. A Scooper Pro Ultra needs them for live status and cleaning; for any other Account they can stay blank. When this entry is running, the new credentials are tried against Aliyun before they are saved.

data_description.aliyun_cloud_key: Prefilled with the stored key, if there is one.
data_description.aliyun_cloud_secret: Leave blank to keep the stored secret.

reconfigure.title: Aliyun credentials

discovery.description: Found {total_count} device(s): {supported_count} fully supported, {unsupported_count} with limited support. Select which devices to add. Supported devices are pre-selected for quick setup.
discovery.title: Discover devices

init.description: Add or remove devices and configure the refresh interval. Changes take effect after reload.
init.title: Manage devices

repeated_eviction.title: CatLink keeps evicting your Session
repeated_eviction.description: The CatLink Cloud allows one Session per Account, so each time Home Assistant reclaims the Session it ends the Session on your phone app, and each time you open the app it evicts Home Assistant. This has happened repeatedly. To stop it, create a second CatLink Account, share your Devices to it, and re-authenticate this integration with that dedicated Account.
